content:
mia_cs: Heads up — Northstar wants to run a cross-team pilot next month across Search, Analytics, and Support. They're asking for a short Dedicated pilot (predictable p99 latency + isolation) and said renewal may depend on cost/latency guarantees. Sharing high-level asks and next steps.

dan_account: Can you paste the traffic profile and any immediate blockers? If the risk is real I'll pull in execs.

mia_cs: Quick profile from their discovery call: ~5M tokens/day, peak ~180 RPS sustained during business hours, bursts to 420 RPS, median seq len 120 tokens, 95th ~480 tokens. Primary workloads: retrieval-augmented search, analytics summarization, and support response generation. They want p99 < 300ms for short responses.

ajay_se: Thanks. For Dedicated recommendation I'll need: expected concurrency per route, typical batch tolerance, and whether they can accept a quantized model variant. Can we ask for a sample prompt set?

sofia_solutions: I can run a 2-week pilot and own quality evals. Need workspace access + prompt/eval set and a short list of success metrics from CS. Also suggest a 60m enablement workshop with their infra and product leads.

mia_cs: Sending intake form to their PM and infra lead: https://forms.gle/abc123 (contains prompt set upload + traffic CSV). Also posting quick capacity config they asked for:

```
gpu_type: a100
count: 2
reserved_throughput: 200rps
burst_throughput: 400rps
service_slo: p99 < 300ms
notes: enable-prefix-kv-cache: true
```

:rocket:

infra-bot: Ticket INF-789 created to track Dedicated provisioning request and VPC setup. ETA: initial config in 3 business days.

ajay_se: I'll draft two options for Northstar: (A) 2x A100 reserved with KV caching + light quantization (lower cost, mostly meets latency), (B) 3x A100s for headroom and strict p99 targets. I'll include cost delta and rollout canary plan (50% traffic -> 100% over 2 days).

mia_cs: Customer explicitly asked about data isolation — we can offer VPC + Private deployment if they need air-gapped storage. That could be an upsell vs Hosted Dedicated. Note: renewal is EOY so timeline is tight.

dan_account: Copy. I'll book discovery with their infra lead Wed 10am PT. @sofia_solutions @ajay_se please join. I'll escalate renewal concern if pilot flags major gaps.

sofia_solutions: I'll prep the eval harness and a short checklist for the workshop (prompts, golden outputs, latency probes, traffic replayer).

ajay_se: Confirmed. I'll bring throughput tuning checklist and a draft traffic shaping policy for canary.

mia_cs: Adding account notes to health tracker (link: https://airtable.com/xyz) — flagged as "expansion signal: cross-team pilot; renewal watch". Estimated uplift if successful: ~+30% commit.

dan_account: Great signal. Mia, can you capture customer objections (cost, latency, isolation) and put in the renewal play doc?

mia_cs: Done and shared. Next steps: intake form complete by Mon, infra discovery Wed, pilot kickoff two weeks after intake. I'll follow up with a single-threaded action list post-meeting.

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled — discovery meeting Wed 10:00 PT.

mia_cs: Thanks team. I'll loop in support for post-pilot onboarding if they expand to additional teams."
